summary: cdk-insights ships worm-style auto-publish and hardcoded C2 exfiltration
details: Package cdk-insights@1.61.0 contains multiple concrete supply-chain attack fingerprints. dist/entry.js and dist/index.js implement an npm auto-publish loop (npm publish invoked from code combined with writeFileSync-driven package.json manipulation at dist/entry.js:2745 and dist/index.js:81/83), consistent with worm-style self-propagation that reuses the installer's npm publish credentials to push malicious versions of other packages. dist/entry.js also performs hardcoded POST exfiltration (L18-L32) to attacker-controlled destinations. dist/aspects/CdkInsightsAspect.js executes ping-based host reconnaissance combined with POST calls, a network+command exfiltration pattern. The combined fingerprints (auto-publish worm mechanics + hardcoded POST C2 + host recon over network) match the Shai-Hulud style npm supply-chain worm.
